title: Sliceform sculpture
summary: a surface from a formula, two woods, half-lap slots
description: A sculpture of two families of laser-cut plywood slices, birch one way and walnut the other, that slide into each other with half-lap slots and show a saddle, a ripple or a ball. Every slot meets its partner half way up its crossing, fitted to your two sheets as measured and to your laser's kerf.
process: Laser cutting of birch and walnut plywood, assembled dry by half-lap slots

difficulty.rationale: Slicing a swept or sphere solid, comb sweeps that put every slot end at half its crossing, closed-form section and strip integrals, and plate limits across the range.

standards: EN 315 thickness tolerances of plywood (4 mm nominal: 3.5 to 4.3 mm), as given in the Handbook of Finnish Plywood (2002), Table 2-3
Handbook of Finnish Plywood (Finnish Forest Industries Federation, 2002), Table 3-1: birch plywood mean density 680 kg/m3
